summary_en: Year-end dividend raised ¥1.00/share to ¥11.00 (from ¥10.00 prior estimate) for FY3/26 ended 30 Sept 2026. Net profit forecast raised ¥45M to ¥910M on gains from equity sale. Payout ratio targeted at 25%.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Consolidated Business Forecast and Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for FY3/26
translation_en_brief: FCE Inc. revised its year-end dividend forecast upward for the fiscal year ended 30 September 2026, raising the per-share payment by ¥1.00 to ¥11.00 from the prior estimate of ¥10.00. Concurrently, the company upgraded its consolidated net income forecast attributable to parent shareholders by ¥45 million to ¥910 million, driven principally by special gains from partial sale of held equity securities and tax recalculation. The company's dividend policy targets a 25% payout ratio on a sustainable basis while maintaining financial soundness. Full-year and operating profit forecasts were held unchanged at ¥6,800 million and ¥1,130 million respectively, as the company intends to invest additional resources into emerging AI-related business operations and shareholder incentive programs to sustain profit growth.
